callbacks.result_semantics: Replace milestone with awarded progress flag0xB0..0xC3 or-1 if already earned. New nonzero milestones increment primary-player friendshipLevel by exactly one with u8 wrap; milestone0 leaves level unchanged. Store the awarded milestone; do not enforce milestone ordering.
preconditions: All consumed operands lie above protected locals/frame metadata. Integer/code-reference payloads or finite s32-representable floats are supported; floats truncate toward zero.

The live actor retains its captured VM and valid owned value storage through the synchronous call. VM/value/actor storage is disjoint from writable profile counters, progress record and primary player fields. No concurrent mutation, context replacement or destruction is covered.

Only established pop/push value/depth effects and the stated gameplay storage writes are reviewed. Scheduling returns continue; no deferred action is installed. Retail reachability, subsequent lifetimes and EEPROM persistence are outside this source/Ghidra review.

Progress storage is initialized: resolved field ID is0..243, encoding is0..7, signed limits match its representation, word/halfword locations are aligned, and its full write range lies within the116-byte save record. Packed fields fit wholly within one byte.

An area-relative selector must index valid selector/current-area storage and resolve to a valid field, never the missing-field sentinel-1. Current area and selector tables remain stable; add resolves separately before reading and writing. Unsupported selectors/layouts are not checked by the helper.

Milestone is0..19 and the retained20-word milestone-to-progress table remains valid. Its mapped flag has initialized packed-one storage. The borrowed primary player is writable at friendshipLevel+0xF6 and friendshipMilestone+0xF8.

Already-earned flag leaves player/save storage unchanged and returns-1. A new flag is written before player fields; no atomic transaction is promised. Level increment wraps modulo256; valid title lookup afterward is a separate precondition.
callbacks.evidence: Source and read-only original Ghidra80121770/80112598/801125AC, original20-word table at80123EB0 and packed-one catalog entries: one integer pop, earned early return-1, progress flag write, conditional byte level increment and milestone word store, saved-VM integer push, continue. Runtime review not performed for this entry.

callbacks.result_semantics: Replace item kind with the sign-extended eight-bit class from catalog offset0x71.
preconditions: Numeric operands lie above every protected local/frame record. Integer/code-reference payloads and finite floats whose truncation is s32-representable are supported. Captured actor, ActorScriptState, VM and owned value storage remain live.

VM/value storage, borrowed globals/catalogs/objects and helper C-stack temporaries do not overlap. Only immediate reviewed pop/push depth/value writes and expressly documented external fields change; no concurrent context replacement, retail reachability or later lifetime behavior is established.

Kind must be0..165; indexing is unchecked. The authored field is u8 but original lb/helper s8 result sign-extends, so bytes128..255 yield negative s32 results. No live-handle or availability query occurs.
